title: (In)finiteness of slopes for Monge-Ampère equations at flat boundary pieces
summary: On any bounded convex domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ with a $d$-dimensional flat boundary piece $F\subset\partialΩ$, we consider convex solutions with zero boundary values to the Monge-Ampère equations $$ \det\mathsf{D}^2 u= \mathrm{dist}(\,\cdot\,,\mathrm{Aff}(F))^α,\quad\det\mathsf{D}^2 u=\mathrm{dist}(\,\cdot\,,\partialΩ)^α,\quad \det\mathsf{D}^2 u=(-u)^α, $$ where $\mathrm{dist}$ stands for Euclidean distance and $\mathrm{Aff}(F)$ is the affine hull of $F$.
